revised_prompt: Create a 3D-rendered Facebook cover for a web development consultancy named Good Flippin Design. The dimensions should adhere to a horizontal banner about an 8:3 ratio, akin to the Facebook cover ratio of 820x312 pixels. The composition should focus on a large, centered circular logo glowing in hues of purple (#8b5cf6) and teal (#10b981) against a deep charcoal background (#0d0d0d) punctuated by a subtle geometric pattern. The ambient lighting should give off a warm and inviting feel, created through subtle amber accents (#fbbf24). Below the logo, there should be clear, readable text that says 'Strategic Web Development'. The overall feel should be professional yet approachable. Note to avoid placing crucial elements in corners to prevent cropping on mobile devices.
